posts.title: John’s Campaign, Care Rights UK and the Patients Association Respond to Covid Inquiry Module 6 Report
posts.author: Leigh Day
posts.excerpt: John's Campaign has been a core participant in modules 2b, 3 and 6 of the UK COVID-19 Inquiry. The pandemic affected everyone and we admire Baroness Hallett's dedication to investigating what happened and what should - and could - have been managed so much better and with more human understanding. Now we need action and we are grateful to Lord Hunt of King's Heath and others for bringing forward the right for people…
